plays.desc_ko: 초반 바텀 2v2. Bie(바드)와 Eddie(시비르)가 사거리 우위를 이용해 Berserker·Isles를 밀어내려 견제. Bie의 우주의 결속(Q)을 Berserker가 옆걸음으로 피하고 관통 화살로 반격.
plays.desc_en: Bie (Bard) and Eddie (Sivir) use their range advantage to poke and zone Berserker and Isles in the early bot 2v2. Berserker sidesteps Bie's Cosmic Binding and answers with Piercing Arrow.
plays.quote: BA and Eddie trying to use the fact that ... they got double range to zone Berserker ... sideep away from the cosmic binding

plays.desc_ko: TSW가 매우 이른 시점에 이중 방어 와드를 설치해 Jarvan의 진입로(강 양쪽 입구) 시야를 확보하려 함. 그러나 해설은 용 둥지를 통과하는 경로를 볼 와드는 없었다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: TSW places two defensive wards very early to cover both river entrances on Jarvan's pathing, but the casters note no ward covers the route through the dragon pit.
plays.quote: double defensive wards there really ... early on from TSW ... TSW trying to cut off the

plays.desc_ko: Inspired(자르반)가 3캠프 후 벽을 넘어 강 와드를 크게 돌아 용 둥지·적 정글을 통해 바텀 진입. Isles가 점멸+갈고리 발사(Hook Shot)로 Eddie를 묶고 Eddie는 도주를 시도하나 Inspired가 깃발 공속으로 어시스트를 얻으며 갱킹을 킬로 연결.
plays.desc_en: After a 3-camp clear, Inspired (Jarvan IV) hops the wall and loops wide around the river ward through the dragon pit and enemy jungle into bot. Isles (Camille) lands Flash + Hook Shot on Eddie (Sivir), and as Eddie tries to flee, Inspired grabs the assist with the Demacian Standard attack speed to convert the gank into a kill.
plays.quote: Jarvin can go over ... So he wraps all the way around ... THE FLASH WITH A HOOK SHOT. EDDIE

plays.desc_ko: 갱킹 후 Inspired의 빠른 귀환 언급과 함께 Isles가 귀환 후 나와 상단 바위게를 Hizto의 동선 변화에 대비해 보호; 해설은 바위게도 확보될 것이라 언급.
plays.desc_en: With Inspired backing quickly after the gank, Isles (Camille) returns to lane and guards the top scuttle against a possible Hizto path change, with the casters expecting LYON to secure it.
plays.quote: Isles on his reset with the ... they guarantee protection on the top ... side scuttle crab

plays.desc_ko: Hizto(신짜오)가 정상 풀클리어 후 미드 갱킹. 세 번째 삼연격 에어본이 Saint에게 적중, Saint는 점멸을 아끼다 늦게 벽 너머로 점멸했으나 에어본 후 사망. 이후 해설은 Hizto의 효율적 클리어+갱킹을 회고.
plays.desc_en: Hizto (Xin Zhao) full clears and ganks mid, landing the third-hit knock-up of Three Talon Strike on Saint (Viktor). Saint holds Flash too long, flashes over the wall late and dies after the knock-up.
plays.quote: to get away from the gank here in the ... histo with the third Talon ... WALL GOES BUT IT'S TOO LITTLE

plays.desc_ko: Saint 사망 직후 Inspired가 Hizto와 한동안 싸워 Hizto를 300HP까지 몰아붙이고 Isles도 합류했으나, Bie와 Dire가 근처에 있어 LYON은 추격을 중단. Hizto는 점멸도 쓰지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Right after Saint's death, Inspired (Jarvan IV) fights Hizto (Xin Zhao) down to 300 HP and Isles joins, but with Bie and Dire nearby LYON abandons the chase. Hizto never used Flash.
plays.quote: Inspired is going to fight histo ... histo down to 300 HP, Isles has ... Lion is not going to

plays.desc_ko: Hizto가 다시 미드를 지나며 Saint를 노림. Saint는 중력장으로 기절을 맞혀 200HP로 생존했으나 순간이동을 이미 사용했고 큰 웨이브가 포탑에 박힐 상황. Inspired가 웨이브 손실을 막으려 미드로 이동.
plays.desc_en: Hizto passes through mid again targeting Saint (Viktor), who survives at 200 HP by stunning with Gravity Field. With Teleport already used and a big wave about to crash into his tower, Inspired heads mid to limit the wave loss.
plays.quote: passing ... through mid again ... as Saint tries

plays.desc_ko: 바텀에서 LYON이 Bie(바드)를 빈사 상태까지 몰았으나 Bie는 신비한 여정(E)으로 벽을 넘어 도주; 한 번의 평타만 더 맞았으면 죽었을 상황에서 생존하며 LYON을 Hizto 갱킹 범위로 끌어들임.
plays.desc_en: LYON pushes Bie (Bard) to near death in bot, but he escapes over a wall with Magical Journey, surviving one auto from death and luring LYON into Hizto's gank range.
plays.quote: as BA's going ... to be taken very low. But he ... with the magical journeys through the

plays.desc_ko: Hizto가 바텀에 나타나 Bie가 끌어들인 LYON 바텀을 역갱. 해설은 TSW가 킬 스코어 2:1로 앞서고 "또 하나의 성공적인 갱킹"이라 진술.
plays.desc_en: Hizto (Xin Zhao) appears bot to counter-gank the LYON duo Bie drew in, with the casters calling it another successful gank as TSW leads 2-1 in kills.
plays.quote: Histo showing up here in the ... bottom lane and it means that Lion loses ... Team Secret Wales two TO ONE

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 너무 앞으로 나온 것을 TSW가 응징("선물을 받음"). Dire는 충격파(R)를 사용했고 미드 궁극기가 교환됨. 해설은 TSW가 Saint(빅토르)를 계속 잡아낸다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: TSW punishes Saint for stepping too far forward, with Dire (Orianna) using Shockwave as mid ultimates are traded. The casters note TSW keeps catching Saint (Viktor).
plays.quote: Saint stepping very far ... TEAM SECRET WALES is happy to ... receive the gift.

plays.desc_ko: Isles가 갈고리 발사로 들어가 Dire의 점멸만 빼냄. 이후 Inspired가 측면에서 Hizto를 노리고 Berserker가 뒤따랐으나 Hizto는 이미 안전 지대로 빠짐.
plays.desc_en: Isles (Camille) goes in with Hook Shot but only forces Dire's Flash. Inspired then flanks toward Hizto with Berserker following, but Hizto has already reached safety.
plays.quote: Isles comes in with a ... hook shot at least gets the flash back ... Inspired now looking from an angle here

plays.desc_ko: 탑에서 Pun(잭스)이 점멸+반격(E)으로 Dhokla(나르)를 기절시키고 나르의 점멸을 빼냄. 점멸 교환.
plays.desc_en: Pun (Jax) uses Flash + Counter Strike to stun Dhokla (Gnar) and force out Gnar's Flash, trading Flashes in top lane.
plays.quote: Flash coming out from Pun ... there with the counter-strike. Gets the ... stun on Dcla. Forces the flash out of

plays.desc_ko: Isles(카밀)가 탑에 올라가 점멸 없는 Pun을 노림. Pun이 공격적으로 교전을 걸었으나 반격(E)이 이미 빠진 상태여서 큰 위험에 빠짐. 해설은 맵 양쪽 1:1 교환이라 정리.
plays.desc_en: Isles (Camille) roams top to target a Flashless Pun. Pun fights aggressively but, with Counter Strike already down, ends up in serious danger; the casters call it a 1-for-1 trade on both sides of the map.
plays.quote: Isles is up there at ... if he'll actually be able to punish this ... Jax who who does not have flash.

plays.desc_ko: 서포터(Isles)가 로밍 간 사이 바텀의 Berserker가 앞으로 나와 있었고, 부메랑 검(Q)을 옆걸음으로 피하려 했으나 Eddie가 점멸로 Q 귀환을 맞혀 킬. 소환사 주문 둘 다 사용.
plays.desc_en: With Isles roaming, Berserker is caught too far forward bot. He tries to sidestep Boomerang Blade, but Eddie (Sivir) flashes to land the returning blade for the kill, with both summoner spells used.
plays.quote: Berserker in ... boomerang blade, but Eddy coming in with ... the flash to get the return on that Q

plays.desc_ko: 공허 유충(그럽) 등장 후 Inspired가 첫 그럽을 치는 중 TSW가 여러 명을 보내 견제. Dhokla는 도착했으나 메가 나르를 이미 잃은 상태. Bie의 운명의 소용돌이(R)와 우주의 결속(Q)이 Inspired를 벽에 묶어 처치(해설은 "dying breath"로 표현).
plays.desc_en: As Inspired hits the first Void Grub, TSW sends several members to contest. Dhokla arrives but has already lost Mega Gnar, and Bie's Tempered Fate and Cosmic Binding pin Inspired (Jarvan IV) to a wall to take him down with his dying breath.
plays.quote: Inspired is working on the first grub, ... sending multiple whales here. ... he's already lost the Mega Nar

plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 첫 그럽 처치를 진행했고, 교전 중 Dhokla가 마지막 그럽을 스틸하여 LYON이 그럽 3개 중 2개 확보.
plays.desc_en: Inspired works on the first grub, and Dhokla (Gnar) steals the last one mid-fight, giving LYON two of three Void Grubs.
plays.quote: DO STEAL ... THE LAST GRUB ... And then DA steals the other

plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 죽기 직전 대격변(R)으로 TSW 3명을 가둬 합류를 지연시키는 사이 Isles와 Saint가 Dire를 쫓음. Dire는 충격파로 버티려 했으나 잡혀 LYON 쪽 2:1.
plays.desc_en: Just before dying, Inspired (Jarvan IV) traps three TSW members with Cataclysm to delay them while Isles and Saint chase Dire. Dire tries to hold with Shockwave but is caught, putting LYON up 2-1.
plays.quote: drops the cataclysm to try to make it a ... Meanwhile, Isles Insane ... going AFTER DRAY. HE TRIES TO SURVIVE

plays.desc_ko: 교전 2라운드: Dhokla가 Hizto로부터 거리를 벌리며 메가 나르 변신 게이지를 채우고, Isles가 바드 밑에서 갈고리를 쐈으나 Bie는 신비한 여정으로 도주. Hizto는 바람이 번개가 되리라(W)로 아군 퇴로 지원. 이후 Dhokla가 메가 나르 벽꿍+바위 던지기 콤보로 Pun을 100HP로 만들고 잭스 궁을 소모시킴. 해설은 LYON이 2명으로 TSW를 붙잡아 지연시켰다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: In the second round, Dhokla (Gnar) kites Hizto to build rage while Isles hooks under Bard, but Bie escapes with Magical Journey and Hizto covers TSW's retreat with Wind Becomes Lightning. Dhokla then lands a Mega Gnar GNAR! into Boulder Toss combo to drop Pun to 100 HP and burn his ultimate, as two LYON players hold TSW up.
plays.quote: We're not done yet. ... trying to kite away from his toe. ... the hook shot. Point blank under the

plays.desc_ko: 그럽 교전 동안 LYON이 2명으로 TSW를 지연시키는 사이 Saint가 미드 웨이브를 밀어냄(해설의 사후 분석).
plays.desc_en: While two LYON players delay TSW at grubs, Saint (Viktor) shoves the mid wave.
plays.quote: though they didn't have Saint with them. ... to delay them with just two players ... while Saint gets the push out on mid

plays.desc_ko: Isles가 탑으로 올라와 대기하던 중 Pun이 부시에서 Isles를 체크하고, Isles는 최대 사거리 갈고리로 빠지려 함. Hizto와 Bie가 합류, Pun이 뛰어들어 Isles가 점멸로 도주를 시도했으나 Pun의 도약 공격으로 처치.
plays.desc_en: Pun checks the brush on Isles waiting top, and she tries to escape with a max-range hook. Hizto and Bie join, Pun dives in, and despite Isles' Flash, Pun's Leap Strike secures the kill.
plays.quote: Isles coming up here into the top side, ... see Pun phase check him here into the ... fires a max range hook shot

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla가 벽꿍+바위 던지기로 2명을 벽에 묶고(2인 메가 나르), Pun이 쓰러짐. Berserker가 순간이동으로 합류해 Hizto에게 딜을 넣어 더블킬. 해설은 LYON이 Saint의 이른 로밍 콜과 함께 5명을 모두 보냈고 Berserker는 탑 포탑 방패도 칠 것이라 언급.
plays.desc_en: Dhokla (Gnar) pins two TSW players to a wall with GNAR! and Boulder Toss, dropping Pun, and Berserker teleports in to damage Hizto for a double kill. LYON committed all five off Saint's early roam call, with Berserker set to hit top tower plating.
plays.quote: Da hits the wall at ... it's a two-man megaar into the ... is already down. Berserker showed up

plays.desc_en: TSW starts the first dragon around 12 minutes, and amid LYON's steal attempt, Hizto (Xin Zhao) smites it timed against Berserker's arrow.
plays.quote: secret Wales have started up the first ... drake of the game. ... SLAIN BY HIS TOE. BEAUTIFULLY DONE.

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 드래곤에 도전. Berserker의 부패의 사슬(R)이 빗나가고 Bie는 신비한 여정으로 빠짐. Inspired와 Berserker가 화살+콤보로 스틸을 노렸으나 Hizto가 먼저 처치.
plays.desc_en: LYON contests the dragon, but Berserker's Chain of Corruption misses and Bie slips away with Magical Journey. Inspired and Berserker try to steal with arrows and combos, but Hizto secures it first.
plays.quote: trying to challenge still. ... Chains of corruption. ... whiff there. BA getting through the

plays.desc_ko: Dhokla가 다시 메가 나르+벽꿍 콤보를 포탑 쪽으로 사용했으나, 잭스 반격의 기절 위협 때문에 바위 던지기로 후속하지 못함.
plays.desc_en: Dhokla uses a Mega Gnar GNAR! combo toward the tower again, but the threat of Jax's Counter Strike stun stops him following with Boulder Toss.

plays.quote: Meanwhile, Saint side lane here. ... So, all the side lanes ... push for Lion.

plays.desc_ko: 트리니티 포스 완성 파워 스파이크에서 Dhokla가 메가 나르로 뛰어들어 벽꿍 후, 한 대가 부족하자 점멸로 따라가 Pun을 솔로킬. 이후 리플레이로 재확인.
plays.desc_en: On his Trinity Force spike, Dhokla dives in as Mega Gnar with GNAR!, then flashes after Pun when one hit short to solo kill him, shown again on replay.
plays.quote: with Da jumping IN. ... THERE'S YOUR WALL UP. ... AND DLA FLASHES IN TO GET IT.

plays.desc_ko: Hizto가 벽을 넘어 W로 Saint에게 진입해 체력 1/3을 깎고, Bie가 운명의 소용돌이로 시간을 벌어줌. Hizto는 버티다 Inspired에게 처형당함.
plays.desc_en: Hizto (Xin Zhao) jumps the wall onto Saint with W, taking a third of his health while Bie buys time with Tempered Fate, but Hizto is executed by Inspired as he holds his ground.
plays.quote: jump over the wall from histo. ... Tries to engage ... onto Saint. Chunks him for about 1/3.

plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 Hizto를 처치하고, TP 합류와 Dhokla(Pun이 부활 대기 중이라 먼저 합류) 참전. Eddie가 압박받고 Dhokla에게 탈진이 걸린 뒤 Pun이 위기. LYON은 1킬을 얻고 모두 안전하게 빠짐; Dhokla는 메가 나르로 변신했으나 남은 대상이 적었음.
plays.desc_en: Inspired kills Hizto, followed by a TP join and Dhokla, who arrives first with Pun on respawn. Eddie is pressured and Pun ends up in danger after Dhokla is Exhausted; LYON takes one kill and everyone escapes, with Dhokla's Mega Gnar transform finding few targets.
plays.quote: TP coming in now. ... Dol's already arrived to the fight and ... Pun's ready to join now too. Eddie under

plays.desc_ko: 교전 후 LYON이 미드 주도권을 얻고 TSW의 칼날부리(그롬프)와 블루 버프를 빼앗음(사후 해설).
plays.desc_en: After the fight, LYON gains mid priority and takes TSW's Gromp and blue buff.
plays.quote: They get mid power off this. ... steal away Gromp and blue buff off this

plays.desc_ko: TSW가 협곡의 전령을 약 5,000HP까지 진행하고 Dire 합류 TP가 들어옴. 이후 전령이 TSW에 의해 미드에서 소환됨(별도 플레이).
plays.desc_en: TSW takes Rift Herald down to about 5,000 HP as Dire's teleport comes in; TSW later summons it mid.
plays.quote: Team Secret Whales already has ... it down to about 5,000 HP. ... They immediately want D

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 전령에 도전하는 척 소환사 주문 쿨만 빼려 했고 본격 교전은 하지 않음. Saint가 쫓아오는 TSW에 준수한 딜을 넣으며 탑 쪽을 방어.
plays.desc_en: LYON fakes a Herald contest to burn summoner cooldowns without fully committing, while Saint (Viktor) deals solid damage to pursuing TSW members and holds the top side.
plays.quote: wants to challenge here for the Rift ... And Lion's ... not going to take the fight.

plays.desc_ko: 전령 시점에 LYON이 Dhokla를 바텀 스플릿에 남겨 2차 포탑까지 밀었고, Berserker는 미드로 이동. 해설은 드래곤 주도권이 LYON에 있다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: During Herald, LYON leaves Dhokla to split bot up to the second tower while Berserker moves mid; the casters say LYON holds dragon priority.
plays.quote: they're going to leave Dola bottom lane ... split pushing. ... the way up to the secondary tower and

plays.desc_en: Isles (Camille) tries to punish Dire (Orianna) top, but Dire backs off; the casters say the timing was poor as LYON's teammates had already left.
plays.quote: they're actually attacking top with the ... Camille trying to punish Oriana, but ... good respect paid from D as he backs up.

plays.desc_ko: 너무 앞으로 나온 Isles를 TSW가 응징. 해설은 "spirit world로 넘어간다"는 표현으로 사망을 묘사하고 Isles가 타이밍을 놓쳤다고 회고.
plays.desc_en: TSW punishes Isles for stepping too far forward, with the casters saying she crosses into the spirit world after missing her timing.
plays.quote: Isles about to tick over into ... the spirit world as he's too far forward ... nice punish on the enemy support.

plays.desc_ko: TSW가 Berserker를 노리고 운명의 소용돌이를 맞혔으나 다른 팀원의 후속이 없음.
plays.desc_en: TSW targets Berserker and Bie lands Tempered Fate, but no teammate follows up.
plays.quote: They're going in after ... Berserker now. They hit the tempered ... fate, but there's no follow up from

plays.desc_ko: TSW가 전령을 미드에 소환해 1차 포탑으로 돌진, 포탑 외피를 깨고 큰 피해를 줬으나 완전 파괴는 못 할 것이라 언급(이후 문장 마스킹).
plays.desc_en: TSW summons Herald mid, charging the first tower to break its plating and deal heavy damage, though not expected to destroy it.
plays.quote: The Rift Herald's already ... going to be summoned mid. Charge towards ... this tier one turret here. Does knock

plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 Hizto의 레드 버프를 스틸하려 했고 Isles와 Bie도 근처에 있었으나 Hizto가 레드를 확보.
plays.desc_en: Inspired (Jarvan IV) tries to steal Hizto's red buff with Isles and Bie nearby, but Hizto secures it.
plays.quote: Inspired stepping up, wants to steal the ... red buff away from his toe. ... Isles and BA

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 탑 1차 포탑을 정리하려 시도.
plays.desc_en: Saint (Viktor) attempts to take down the top outer tower.
